title: Adaptively Sparse Transformers
answer_short: by allowing attention heads to choose between focused or spread-out behavior and uncovering different head specializations
answer_rationale: The model improves interpretability by replacing softmax with α-entmax, which allows low-scoring words to receive zero weight, enabling more focused attention patterns. This sparsity helps uncover different head specializations and increases head diversity, as noted in Text 2 and Text 9. The adaptively sparse attention mechanism dynamically adjusts sparsity, enhancing interpretability without sacrificing accuracy.
